target: SWE intern / new-grad roles (general software engineering, 2026–27 recruiting cycle)
seven_second_takeaway: UMD CS '28, current AWS SDE intern, prior Capital One SWE intern, Amazon contract work, AWS cert. Strong brands — but the page is a dense wall of bold tech names.

score_rationale.impact_clarity: Results buried at the end of 2–3 line sentences; several bullets (Leo deploy, Bedrock fine-tuning, UMIACS training) have no clear outcome.
score_rationale.quantification: Numbers exist but baselines are fuzzy: '90% satisfaction report', '93% on internal test users', 34% speedup of what metric?
score_rationale.technical_depth: Real engineering is present but often reads as a chain of AWS service names rather than a design decision.
score_rationale.concision_readability: Capital One and Amazon bullets are 3 lines each; 4–6 bolded terms per bullet, so bold stops guiding the eye.
score_rationale.skim_test: Brands are there, but the top headline role (AWS) has one vague bullet and the wins are hidden in bold noise.
score_rationale.credibility: Five overlapping concurrent roles plus a project during Capital One raises load questions; some phrasing feels LLM-polished.
score_rationale.ats_parseability: Clean extraction, but phone is a placeholder and date formats are inconsistent (June 2026 vs Sep 2026).
score_rationale.visual_layout: One page and aligned, but very dense; Certifications above Experience pushes the strongest content down.
score_rationale.domain_fit: General SWE signals are strong, but AI/cloud-service emphasis outweighs core SWE fundamentals in the first read.
score_rationale.overall: Brands carry it into interviews at most places; the density and vague AWS entry keep it out of the top tier.

must_fix: Replace the (XXX) XXX-XXXX phone placeholder with a real number or remove it.
Clarify: what the AWS Redshift internship involves — one generic 'researching and implementing' bullet undersells the most important brand on the page.
Cut bolding to 1–2 anchors per bullet; currently almost every noun is bold.
Bring every bullet to ≤2 lines; Capital One and Amazon contract bullets are 3-line walls.
Clarify: the scope/hours of the overlapping roles (AWS intern, Amazon contract, UMIACS, TerpLabs all 'Present') so it doesn't read as inflated.
